question: In the photocatalytic ozonation study of Pd/Cu-modified rutile TiO2 and g-C3N4, how many times higher than ozonation alone was the sulfamethoxazole pseudo-first-order rate constant of (Pd/Cu)TiO2 at 1% loading?
rendered:
According to the excerpt from page 10 of the paper "Mechanistic Divergence and Ozone Mass Transfer Enhancement in Photocatalytic Ozonation: A Comparative Study of Bimetallic Pd/Cu-Modified Rutile TiO2 and g‑C3N4", the pseudo-first-order rate constant for (Pd/Cu)TiO2 at 1% loading was 2.4 times higher than ozonation alone.

The calculation is not necessary, as the answer is directly provided in the excerpt.
